say:1:1322105001:1.text: Last night, I went to Whiteridge Temple to pray and unintentionally heard townsfolk requesting help from the acolytes.
say:1:1322105001:1.source_cn: 昨天晚上我去白山修道院祷告，无意中听到有镇民来向修士求助。

choice_prompt:2:1322105001.text: Last night, I went to Whiteridge Temple to pray and unintentionally heard townsfolk requesting help from the acolytes.
choice_prompt:2:1322105001.source_cn: 昨天晚上我去白山修道院祷告，无意中听到有镇民来向修士求助。

say:3:1322105002:1.text: Yes, being in the temple makes me feel closer to the goddess. Don't worry, though—I go quietly, and no one ever notices me.
say:3:1322105002:1.source_cn: 嗯……在修道院里，我感觉能更靠近女神。别担心，我都是悄...

say:4:1322105005:1.text: Since the Hierophant fell and most of the acolytes perished, there's been no one left to manage the temple. Everything's in disarray, and the remaining acolytes are too overwhelmed to help the townsfolk right now.
say:4:1322105005:1.source_cn: 可自从大主教恶堕，修士修女死亡，修道院就无人管理。现在...

say:5:1322105006:1.text: Can you go to the temple and take a look? Maybe there is something that you can help with.
say:5:1322105006:1.source_cn: 你们能去修道院看看吗？如果可以的话，希望你们能帮帮他们。

say:6:1322105007:1.text: Yes, of course! We'll gladly help anyone in need.
say:6:1322105007:1.source_cn: 当然啦，这是我们说好的，我们现在就去！

choice:2:0:1.text: You still pray at the temple?
choice:2:0:1.male: You still pray at the temple?
choice:2:0:1.female: You still pray at the temple?

say:8:1322105003:1.text: Yes, even though the temple has been damaged by evil forces, its spirit remains unbroken. The Divine Light will one day restore it to its former glory.
say:8:1322105003:1.source_cn: 我明白……那座教堂被邪恶的力量毁得不成样子，但它的本质...

say:9:1322105004:1.text: I have been a follower of Dura since I was a child. Even if I am a Graveborn now, my faith has not changed.
say:9:1322105004:1.source_cn: 我从小就是女神的信徒，即使成为了亡灵，我也不会改变我的信仰。
